description: Identify error patterns that recur across multiple Canton SDK or Splice release windows: structural bugs the ecosystem keeps hitting versus one-off regressions. Returns the top keywords/error codes mentioned in forum_posts that span at least 3 distinct months over the last 18 months. Canton/Daml/Splice ecosystem only. Useful for triage prioritisation and for choosing what to add to a runbook.

min_months.description: A keyword must appear in this many distinct months to count as recurring (default 3).

name: get_recurring_issue_fingerprint
